description: Defines the HelpTopicTwigLoader class for loading help topic Twig templates from the filesystem, including handling front matter and template discovery within Drupal modules and themes.

classes.name: HelpTopicTwigLoader
classes.description: A Twig filesystem loader extension for loading help topic templates from module and theme directories, with support for front matter parsing and template validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with root path and module/theme handlers, adding help_topics directories.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a help_topics directory from a given path to the Twig loader if it exists.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source content of a template, parsing front matter and handling YAML errors.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Finds a template by name, ensuring it ends with .html.twig, or throws an error.
